assistant:
On proposal **bus4_gen2mw** (base network plus a 2 MW dispatchable generator at Bus 4, holding 1.000 p.u.), the grid stayed within the normal-operation limits throughout **2000-01-01**: no voltage or thermal violations in 96 measurements. At the day’s most stressed point, 19:15, minimum voltage was **0.995 p.u.**, peak line loading **31.4%**, and peak transformer loading **67.9%**.

**It is not N-1 secure at that point.** The screen tested 17 line and transformer outages; 14 caused load disconnection, so the system was flagged not secure—even though the screen reported no voltage or thermal violations. For example, loss of transformer T0 disconnects **18.64 MW** of load, and loss of T1 disconnects **15.88 MW**. The new generator does not prevent those disconnections.

The generator’s reactive limits were set to **−1.239 to +1.239 MVAr** in the proposal. The N-1 result is for 19:15 only, so this does not establish N-1 security at other times or across the full day.
